title: 3849. Maximum Bitwise XOR After Rearrangement

examples.explanation: One optimal rearrangement of t is "011". The bitwise XOR of s and rearranged t is "101" XOR "011" = "110", which is the maximum possible.
One optimal rearrangement of t is "1011". The bitwise XOR of s and rearranged t is "0110" XOR "1011" = "1101", which is the maximum possible.
One optimal rearrangement of t is "1010". The bitwise XOR of s and rearranged t is "0101" XOR "1010" = "1111", which is the maximum possible.
